format: makefile (or embedded shell scripting in Makefile)
description: This file contains Makefile directives and shell scripts related to building and managing root filesystem images, libraries, and packages in a build system, including conditional definitions based on configuration options.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: A macro that compiles, strips, and copies libraries with dependencies for target root filesystem.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines a command alias for performing package management tasks with opkg, including installation and removal.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines a command alias for managing packages with apk, using specific root and key parameters.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: A macro that cleans up package management state files and metadata.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: A macro that prepares the root filesystem directory for deployment, including copying files, enabling/disabling service scripts, and cleaning up build artifacts.
